"""Tests for WebEngine certificate decision wrappers."""

import pytest

from qutebrowser.browser.webengine import certificateerror
from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes


class FakeError:

    def __init__(self):
        self.accepted = False
        self.rejected = False
        self.deferred = False

    def acceptCertificate(self):
        self.accepted = True

    def rejectCertificate(self):
        self.rejected = True

    def defer(self):
        self.deferred = True


@pytest.mark.parametrize('qt6, wrapper_type', [
    (False, certificateerror.CertificateErrorWrapperQt5),
    (True, certificateerror.CertificateErrorWrapperQt6),
])
def test_factory_and_decisions(monkeypatch, qt6, wrapper_type):
    monkeypatch.setattr(certificateerror.machinery, 'IS_QT6', qt6)
    error = FakeError()
    wrapper = certificateerror.create(error)
    assert isinstance(wrapper, wrapper_type)
    assert not wrapper.certificate_was_accepted()

    if qt6:
        wrapper.defer()
        assert error.deferred
    else:
        with pytest.raises(usertypes.UndeferrableError):
            wrapper.defer()

    wrapper.accept_certificate()
    assert wrapper.certificate_was_accepted()
    assert error.accepted == qt6
    wrapper.reject_certificate()
    assert not wrapper.certificate_was_accepted()
    assert error.rejected == qt6
